name: What Now? You've Saved the World but What About Your Love Life?
summary:
You've conquered every dungeon, grinded to max level, found every collectable... but you still don't have a girlfriend.

What Now is a top-down adventure game made in the style of third and fourth generation console RPGs. You play as a Dragon Quest-esque hero after he's already saved the world and who is now trying to figure out what to do with his life. Explore a fantasy world without enemies and help various NPCs deal with their newly peaceful lives with the ultimate goal of finding a girlfriend. Inspired by Moon RPG, Undertale, and Tokimeki Memorial.
